 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. ESPN 's "College GameDay" is in Boise, Idaho in Week 11 for the game between the Oregon State Beavers and Boise State Broncos . Pat McAfee and crew are set up at DeChevrieux Field outside Albertsons Stadium and as usual, the fans have turned out with signs, hoping to share a message with the viewers at home.
 This is just the second time that ESPN's premiere college football pregame show has traveled to Boise so fans had more than a decade to think of clever signs. And yet you get the feeling that some of them may have waited until the last second.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement MORE: College football schedule facing major disruptions from FAA nationwide grounding 
 Best College GameDay signs at Boise State
 One fan took a serious shot at the visitors suggesting they wouldn't make a 48 team playoff. Unfortunately, we're still probably years from finding out what a 48-team playoff might look like. If the field was half that, Boise State is ranked No. 24 in the latest CFP rankings .
 One student made a vow that he and those around him will soon regret. Even the GameDay account had to get a joke off about the idea of someone not showering until Boise State wins a title.
 The jokes in these signs can be marked safe for work. Poor Beavers, always having people use dams against them.
 Even Kirk Herbstreit's dog was the target of a sign that depicted him as a bit of a hostage. Does anyone have the heart to tell the person who spent all that time making the sign that no dog who gets to eat steak in a fancy restaurant wants to be a horse.
